title: Roof Replacement in Sandy, OR
summary: In September 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Sandy, OR. The crew tore off the old shingles down to the wood deck, put in new plywood decking, laid Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles in a brown blend with new attic vents, flashings and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off all layers of old roofing down to the wood deck
The job included 20 sheets of new plywood decking
Installed Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment over the deck
New painted drip edge and gable flashing, plus a self-sealing starter course
Installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles with woven valleys and standard ridge cap
New front wall and sidewall flashing, new power pole flashing and new double-seal vent pipe flashings
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard

faqs.answer: Yes. The job included 20 sheets of new plywood decking under the new underlayment and shingles.
